title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: voice recognition set in device settings instead of PowerShell
summary: Hold: the transcription checklist directs administrators to check the room resource account's policy, but Microsoft requires transcription permission for the meeting organiser and the user who starts recording or transcription. The device settings, licensing, recognition default and roadmap details are supported; a few documentation qualifications and a missing checklist control also need correction.
